description: This file is a C++ header defining utility functions related to host tools versioning, including functions to calculate CRCs for files and a mapping of host tools CRCs within the 'cuttlefish' namespace.

methods.name: FileCrc
methods.description: Computes CRC checksum for the file specified by the given path.

methods.name: HostToolsCrc
methods.description: Returns a map of host tool names to their CRC checksums.
